_comment: Runtime configuration, read once at boot. Committed with empty values so a
fresh checkout runs in demo mode with no setup and no 404 on first load.
To point this at a Supabase project, fill in the two values below — see
config.example.json for what they are and BACKEND.md for where to find
them. On a server you do not edit this by hand: deploy/docker-entrypoint.sh
rewrites it from SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY at container start.
The anon key is a public credential and is meant to reach browsers. It
grants nothing on its own — every table has row-level security and an
unauthenticated caller gets zero rows. Never put the service_role key here.
